features: ULTRA SOFT MATERIAL & SIZE: Made of soft polyester and cotton blend, comfortable to touch and lay on. 18 x 18”/45 x 45cm (1-2cm deviation), PILLOW INSERTS NOT INCLUDED.

PERSONALITY CAPITAL LETTERS PATTERN: There is a capital alphabet “A-Z” surrounded by flowers with pure white background, You can choose your favorite one. the print is only on one side. The delicate invisible zipper was designed to meet an elegant look and refill pillow easily.

SUITABLE OCCASIONS & PRESENTS: The pillow protectors can match whichever color tone you like, the simple and elegant design are perfect for home decoration, sofa, chairs, car decoration, office, and hotel, coffee decoration. Besides, it can be used as a perfect gift for your parents, friends, classmates or kids.

CHILD AND PET FRIENDLY: Thanks to the high-quality short plush material, It has elasticity with good water absorption, no hair loss, no pilling and has no stimulation to the skin. So don't worry that these will be harmful to children and pets.

WASHING GUIDE: Machine washable, separately from other dark or easy to fade articles, gentle circle in low. No bleach. Tumble Dry Low. Because different screens display, the color of the actual pillow cover may vary slightly.
